raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Overview

Preserve `random-mm` and `random-rerank` in `vllm bench throughput` when no dataset path is supplied. Previously, argument validation replaced either selection with `random`, so the documented multimodal command sampled text-only requests.

## Claims

- Keep the requested synthetic dataset through validation; retain the existing default random-text fallback and `prefix_repetition` behavior.
- Verify throughput's parser, validation, and shared sampler produce image-bearing chat requests without `--dataset-path`, using a separate test from the existing `mm-processor` regression.
- Reject `random-rerank --no-reranker` workloads with `--random-batch-size <= 1` or `--num-prompts <= 1` using a clear `ValueError`, with or without `--dataset-path`. Preserve valid reranker and non-reranker configurations.

## Validation

Run in WSL with a uv-managed Python 3.12 environment and an existing CPU installation, with this checkout first on `PYTHONPATH`.

```bash
PYTHONPATH=. .venv/bin/python -m pytest tests/benchmarks/test_throughput_cli.py -q -k invalid_non_reranker_sizes
```

Before the new validation guards: **6 failed, 17 deselected** because invalid sizes did not raise `ValueError`.

```bash
PYTHONPATH=. .venv/bin/python -m pytest tests/benchmarks/test_throughput_cli.py -q -k "not test_bench_throughput" --disable-warnings
PYTHONPATH=. .venv/bin/python -m pytest tests/benchmarks/test_throughput_cli.py::test_bench_throughput_accepts_custom_audio_args -q --disable-warnings
pre-commit run --files vllm/benchmarks/throughput.py tests/benchmarks/test_throughput_cli.py docs/benchmarking/cli.md
pre-commit run mypy --verbose --files vllm/benchmarks/throughput.py tests/benchmarks/test_throughput_cli.py
git diff --check
```

After the fix: **21 passed, 2 deselected**, plus the separately selected custom-audio parser test **1 passed**. The only unrun test in this file is the model-running `test_bench_throughput`. All applicable pre-commit hooks passed; the configured mypy hook targets Python 3.11 and reported no issues in both files. Whitespace checks passed.

No GPU benchmark or model accuracy evaluation was run; the changes concern benchmark workload selection and argument validation. Existing Benchmarks CLI CI runs `tests/benchmarks/` on NVIDIA and AMD. These results are local validation, not an upstream CI pass.

## Details

The no-path fallback exempted only `prefix_repetition`. Add the other two pathless synthetic datasets to that exemption, leaving the existing `random` validation path intact. Clarify the documented `random-mm` invocation.

Preserving `random-rerank` also exposes an existing sampler assertion for `--no-reranker`: a query occupies one input and one batch slot, so both counts must exceed one. Validate the main workload's counts before sampling; the checks are outside the no-path fallback so explicit dataset paths receive the same errors. The shared sampler and warmup handling are unchanged.

Duplicate-work checks found no other open PR addressing this fix. Searches included `"random-mm" "throughput.py"`, `"throughput" "dataset" in:title`, `"random-rerank"`, and related validation/fallback terms. Reviewed nearby work includes #41541 (benchmark metadata), #55937 (Rust timed-trace support), and closed #36035 (length-argument defaults). Searches were refreshed while addressing review feedback.

AI assistance was used: Codex helped investigate the bug, implement the change, write tests, run validation, review the diff, and prepare this description.

---

<details>
<summary> Pull Request Checklist </summary>

- [x] I used vLLM's `/pr-checklist` skill. (Mandatory for agents, optional for humans).
- [x] AI assistance was used during the creation of this PR.

- [x] **Design Fit:** Minimizes impact on core components, reuses existing functionality, and justifies added complexity.
- [x] **Testing and Validation:** Validates the change and ensures any added tests are meaningful and reliable, with CI coverage or documented CI resource constraints and validation performed outside CI.
- [x] **Code Quality and Style:** Keeps code and comments clear and concise, and updates relevant documentation and examples.
- [x] **Pull Request Contents:** Includes a brief summary and relevant links, supports claims with evidence, explains root causes and implementation trade-offs, and follows the contributing guide.
</details>
